decision: No source-level blocker identified for this bounded proposal; no native or translation execution clearance is given.

independent_findings.finding: All 37 source bindings and 19 manifest entries verify. Every non-format request field is exactly the rejected source-spelling predecessor: six complete sources, original generic prompts/source-spelling map, model/options and historical adapter are unchanged. All 13 source-derived mentions retain exact same-entry slices, offsets and original metadata. Criteria remain unchanged and are not algorithm inputs.

The exact b11901 converter source has an items-array tuple branch emitting each position once. Each fixed two-position schema supplies an anchored pattern containing each entry-owned marker once in every permitted permutation. Unique IDs and maximum three mentions bound each entry to at most six alternatives; no cross-entry marker coalescing or source cropping is introduced.

The pinned pattern converter directly wraps its generated body rule in JSON quotes. The proposed raw-body GAP therefore addresses its actual representation: literal Unicode plus standard short escapes; raw control characters, quotes, backslashes, less-than signs and Unicode escapes cannot enter outside their declared branches. Exact tags are literal and immutable. Escaped tags, moved tags, duplicate/unknown tags and reserved opening/closing forms are rejected by the intended profile; normalization-equivalent forms still require the unchanged postguard.

independent_findings.topic: Native support is not yet established
independent_findings.finding: Source inspection confirms noncapturing groups, alternation, repetition, character classes and hex escapes, but unsupported constructs revert to unrestricted strings with warnings. Existing Python/scanner agreement is not native enforcement evidence. All 285 native acceptance fields correctly remain null. Actual converter diagnostics, exact emitted GBNF, strict schema identity and all fixed positive/negative raw strings must pass a separately authorized pinned native validator before generation.

The official validator uses the native raw-character grammar engine without model vocabulary and returns exit0 after both an accepted and a rejected input. A future wrapper must distinguish the complete explicit accepted/rejected status lines, reject ambiguity/initialization failure and never use exit0 or a loose valid-substring test as acceptance.

This mechanism cannot enforce pronouns, actor roles, quantities, negation, conditions, concrete propositions or ordinary prose completeness. Tag-only strings and unsupported new claims can satisfy exact marker syntax. Allowed permutations intentionally leave within-entry relationships unconstrained. Existing failures stay rejected; this review gives no model promotion or v2/v3/integration approval.

required_next_preparation: Concrete reproducible pinned validator acquisition/build identity and exact acceptance parser, with no model vocabulary dependency.
Native setup runner with receipt gates, exact seven frozen query bodies, actual six rendered prompts/token vectors, captured converter warnings/grammars and negative unsupported-lookahead sentinel.
Every one of the 285 fixed probes against actual emitted grammar, independently reviewed before any translation authorization.

Preserve the reviewed 4096 context/2048 output/4CPU/6144MiB process-group cap, resource completeness, raw preguard output, unload/owned-group cleanup, first operational failure stop and no retry/repair.
